dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Falcons (3-7) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Vikings
bullets: Roster & Front Office: Atlanta signed CB Terell Smith to the practice squad [Dave Choate](https://www.thefalcoholic.com/atlanta-falcons-roster/98684/breaking-down-falcons-2026-acquisitions-through-the-bye-ian-cunningham-gervon-dexter).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Kevin Stefanski and the medical staff evaluate WR Zachariah Branch (hamstring), LB Divine Deablo (forearm), and LB Kendal Daniels (Achilles) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Daniel Flick](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4870612/zachariah-branch#:~:text=Branch%20%28hamstring%29%20went%20through%20warmups%20during%20the).

Week 12 Vikings Outlook: Kevin Stefanski and DC Jeff Ulbrich open installation for the Minnesota Vikings (7-3, MIN -7, HC Kevin O'Connell, OC Wes Phillips & DC Brian Flores (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Points Allowed / Game (16.1) as Atlanta prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Kevin Knight](https://www.thefalcoholic.com/atlanta-falcons-odds/98620/falcons-vs-vikings-odds-week-12-opening-lines-point-spread-total) [atlantafalcons.com Official](https://www.atlantafalcons.com/news/week-12-nfl-power-rankings-roundup-falcons-return-from-bye-lions-contending-giants-jaguars).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-7 (4th in NFC South • #13 Seed in NFC), Atlanta carries a 8.8% postseason projection, 8.7% NFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Aaron Freeman](https://www.thefalcoholic.com/atlanta-falcons-analysis/98720/michael-penixs-fifth-year-option-is-now-a-coin-flip-for-the-falcons).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Atlanta ranks #23 in Points / Game (20.1), #24 in Points Allowed / Game (25.8), #30 in Turnover Differential (-10), giving Kevin Stefanski and Jeff Ulbrich a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 1:00 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Minnesota Vikings [Kevin Knight](https://www.thefalcoholic.com/atlanta-falcons-analysis/98697/what-do-we-need-to-see-from-the-falcons-over-the-final-games-of-2026).
